_doc: Status overrides for implementation-ledger.md (hand-edited; build-cue-ledger.mjs never overwrites this file). Each value: {"status": "TODO|IN_PROGRESS|IMPLEMENTED|VALIDATED|BLOCKED|N/A", "evidence": "", "files": "", "notes": ""}. Key grammar: family:R07 | asset:04-A03 | scene:04 | cat:<ref>-<catnum> (e.g. cat:04-01) | ref:<ref> (e.g. ref:04) | for:<forensics section number> | ut:S<shot>-<n> | decision:<n> | cue:<master cue id e.g. 04-C012>. Sections in this file: "family", "asset", "scene", "cat", "ref", "for", "ut", "decision", "cue" hold the keys after the colon (i.e. family:R07 is stored as {"family":{"R07":{...}}}); flat "family:R07" keys are also accepted. "defaults" may hold {"family":"TODO","asset":"TODO","cue":"TODO",...} fallback statuses. Cue status resolution: cue > cat > ref > defaults.cue > TODO. Asset status: asset > scene > defaults.asset > TODO. Forensics: for > defaults.for > TODO.
